crossRefs.note: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called to himself the elders of the assembly.
Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

people.name: Miletus

people.name: Samos

people.name: Trogyllium
people.line: A city near Ephesus, visited by Paul

translations.web: Sailing from there, we came the following day opposite Chios. The next day we touched at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium, and the day after we came to Miletus.
translations.bsb: Sailing on from there, we arrived the next day opposite Chios. The day after that we arrived at Samos, and on the following day we came to Miletus.
translations.kjv: And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.
translations.asv: And sailing from thence, we came the following day over against Chios; and the next day we touched at Samos; and the day after we came to Miletus.
